# opnsense_trafficshaper_queue (Data Source)

Traffic shaper queues share the bandwidth of a pipe between traffic classes by weight.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the resource.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Number) Number of hash buckets for dynamic queues.
- `codel_ecn_enable` (Boolean) When enabled, CoDel marks packets with ECN instead of dropping them.
- `codel_enable` (Boolean) When enabled, CoDel active queue management is used. Cannot be combined with `pie_enable`.
- `codel_interval` (Number) CoDel interval in milliseconds.
- `codel_target` (Number) CoDel target queue delay in milliseconds.
- `description` (String) Description of the queue. Rules refer to the queue by UUID, the GUI shows this text.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this entry is enabled.
- `mask` (String) Create a dynamic queue per address: `none`, `src-ip`, `dst-ip`, `src-ip6` or `dst-ip6`. Masking by source or destination shares the bandwidth per host instead of across all traffic.
- `number` (Number) Number OPNsense assigned to the queue (ipfw queue number).
- `pie_enable` (Boolean) When enabled, PIE active queue management is used. Cannot be combined with `codel_enable`.
- `pipe` (String) UUID of the pipe this queue draws its bandwidth from.
- `weight` (Number) Share of the pipe bandwidth this queue gets relative to the other queues on the same pipe, from `1` to `100`.
